content: Sarah aherrety 127 anenh, apmer Kiriath Arba ilwemel-antey ikwer-itwek-antey. Apmer itna ingweran Hebron, Canaan-itwek.
Abraham rarl amperrngirrek ikwer. Ikwer-penh Abraham Hitt-kenh-rnem-warl alhek, ra renh-rnem ayerney-alhek,
“Ayengan alethang. Nthenhek atha anew atyenh arrewaly akwernem? Apmer mwerr ngay ntwa akely atyenh anthem?”
Rernem angkek, “Ngarl Atyetyart ilkwan intey nthenhek ngarl arlkwententyelan? Kel, ntwa intey yanhek anew ngkwenh arrewaly akwerna.”
Abraham angkek, “Ephron ayernerr-arey intey renh parrik impalth-itwek tharlemiletyek. Atha man ilkwan anthem, arrantherr ayenh ingkerrel aytaretyek, atharl anthem.”
Ephron apmerek-artwey, artwa Hitt-kenh apmer tern ilkwa arriw-itwek-antey anenh. Abraham-el apmer ikwer ayernek.
Ephron angkek, “Kel, intey atha anthey, ingwerel-rneman ngenh aytaremel ntwarl atyeng-they intey ineman.”
Abraham angkek, “Man ilkwa innga atha ngenh anthem, arraty-angkwarr.”
Ephron ra ilek, “Menty! Thilp 400 ntwa payemeley-areny inteyekey! Arwa ngkweng aknga, man-weny. Atha ngenh menty anthek, man-weny-anem.”

Abraham-el artwa Hitt-kenh 400 thilp anthek, artwa akngerrel aytarek-angkwarr. Alakenh Abraham-el apmer Ephron-kenh payemelek ikwerant-anem, ikwerenh-rnem-akert, intey-akert, arrewaly renh akwernetyek. Apmer ranap arwerl-angketyarr.
Abraham-el anew ikwerenh intey ikwer-itwek akwernek, rarl payemelek-itwek, Hitt-kenh-rnem-itwek.
